title: UPC Provenance Stamp
description: Embedded on every derived object (representation, extraction, generation, synthesis). Records who/what produced it, when, how, and what it was derived from. input_digest lives here and only here.

tool.description: Software that created the object; "manual" for a human edit.

model.description: Present when a model produced the object.

method.description: How the object was produced (http, readability, ocr, conversion, vision, model, manual, import, …). Read by the trust boundary (§05) and the browser badges.

person.description: Set when a human produced or edited the object.

modified_at.description: Set when the object is later corrected in place by an allowed edit; created_at is preserved.

input_digest.description: sha256 of the exact bytes consumed (single input) or of the JCS input manifest (multi-input, §07). Drives staleness.

activity_ref.description: Optional evt-id linking to the activity journal.
